whenToUse: Order details, profiles, or product specs.
Small actions such as copy sit next to values.
whenNotToUse: Several items are compared (use a data table).
Values must be edited in place (use a form).

alternatives.name: Data Table
alternatives.reason: Comparing the same values across several items.

accessibility: Use dl, dt, and dd so values are read with their names.
Name the section with a heading.
The copy button next to a value shows the result in words.
The reading order stays the same on narrow screens.
